name: King EX75
description: King EX75 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX75N noise reduction (1987). THRESHOLD -50 to -10 dB, RATIO 1:1 to 1:8 (gentle expander to hard gate), 0.3 ms attack, DECAY 0.2 to 2 s, a 6 dB/oct FILTER (200 Hz to 5 kHz) that rolls the hiss off when the sound gets quiet, REDUCTION light, EFFECT in/out.
author: The Disk King
